\section[(dialogue)]{Wanting and planning — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R119-first-pass-wanting-and-planning}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for dinner and vinegar.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a tool, to own, to lose, to keep, a talent
  \item to long for, an expectation, enthusiasm, a wish, a preference
  \item longing, ambition, a purpose, a project, a suggestion
  \item interest, to hate, a desire, a dream, hope
  \item a goal, a plan, a need, to need, to wish
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A tool? (\textbf{\ar{أداة}}, \emph{adāt}.) To own? (\textbf{\ar{ملك}}, \emph{malaka}.) To lose? (\textbf{\ar{خسر}}, \emph{khasira}.) To keep? (\textbf{\ar{حفظ}}, \emph{ḥafiẓa}.) A talent? (\textbf{\ar{موهبة}}, \emph{mawhiba}.) To long for? (\textbf{\ar{اشتاق}}, \emph{ishtāqa}.) An expectation? (\textbf{\ar{توقع}}, \emph{tawaqquʿ}.) Enthusiasm? (\textbf{\ar{حماس}}, \emph{ḥamās}.) A wish? (\textbf{\ar{أمنية}}, \emph{umniyya}.) A preference? (\textbf{\ar{تفضيل}}, \emph{tafḍīl}.) Longing? (\textbf{\ar{شوق}}, \emph{shawq}.) Ambition? (\textbf{\ar{طموح}}, \emph{ṭumūḥ}.) A purpose? (\textbf{\ar{غاية}}, \emph{ghāya}.) A project? (\textbf{\ar{مشروع}}, \emph{mashrūʿ}.) A suggestion? (\textbf{\ar{اقتراح}}, \emph{iqtirāḥ}.) Interest? (\textbf{\ar{اهتمام}}, \emph{ihtimām}.) To hate? (\textbf{\ar{كره}}, \emph{kariha}.) A desire? (\textbf{\ar{رغبة}}, \emph{raghba}.) A dream? (\textbf{\ar{حلم}}, \emph{ḥulm}.) Hope? (\textbf{\ar{أمل}}, \emph{amal}.) A goal? (\textbf{\ar{هدف}}, \emph{hadaf}.) A plan? (\textbf{\ar{خطة}}, \emph{khuṭṭa}.) A need? (\textbf{\ar{حاجة}}, \emph{ḥāja}.) To need? (\textbf{\ar{احتاج}}, \emph{iḥtāja}.) To wish? (\textbf{\ar{تمنى}}, \emph{tamannā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Things in the house — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R119-second-pass-things-in-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a decision and to choose.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a decision, to choose, to prefer, to ask for, an intention
  \item a jug, a frying pan, an oven, a fan, a computer
  \item a television, a newspaper, a magazine, a letter, an envelope
  \item a present, a ticket, a passport, a wallet, an umbrella
  \item a glove, a scarf, lunch, dinner, vinegar
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A decision? (\textbf{\ar{قرار}}, \emph{qarār}.) To choose? (\textbf{\ar{اختار}}, \emph{ikhtāra}.) To prefer? (\textbf{\ar{فضل}}, \emph{faḍḍala}.) To ask for? (\textbf{\ar{طلب}}, \emph{ṭalaba}.) An intention? (\textbf{\ar{نية}}, \emph{niyya}.) A jug? (\textbf{\ar{إبريق}}, \emph{ibrīq}.) A frying pan? (\textbf{\ar{مقلاة}}, \emph{miqlāh}.) An oven? (\textbf{\ar{فرن}}, \emph{furn}.) A fan? (\textbf{\ar{مروحة}}, \emph{mirwaḥa}.) A computer? (\textbf{\ar{حاسوب}}, \emph{ḥāsūb}.) A television? (\textbf{\ar{تلفاز}}, \emph{tilfāz}.) A newspaper? (\textbf{\ar{جريدة}}, \emph{jarīda}.) A magazine? (\textbf{\ar{مجلة}}, \emph{majalla}.) A letter? (\textbf{\ar{رسالة}}, \emph{risāla}.) An envelope? (\textbf{\ar{ظرف}}, \emph{ẓarf}.) A present? (\textbf{\ar{هدية}}, \emph{hadiyya}.) A ticket? (\textbf{\ar{تذكرة}}, \emph{tadhkira}.) A passport? (\textbf{\ar{جواز}}, \emph{jawāz}.) A wallet? (\textbf{\ar{محفظة}}, \emph{miḥfaẓa}.) An umbrella? (\textbf{\ar{مظلة}}, \emph{miẓalla}.) A glove? (\textbf{\ar{قفاز}}, \emph{quffāz}.) A scarf? (\textbf{\ar{وشاح}}, \emph{wishāḥ}.) Lunch? (\textbf{\ar{غداء}}, \emph{ghadāʾ}.) Dinner? (\textbf{\ar{عشاء}}, \emph{ʿashāʾ}.) Vinegar? (\textbf{\ar{خل}}, \emph{khall}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
